notes.title: Movie Edit Pro Plus: Version 2017 Awakens
notes.notes:
Important improvements in version 16.0.3.64 compared to version 16.0.2.56
	Stability: several error and bug fixes to prevent crashing	Usability: corrected cursor flickering above preview pane	Effects: minor corrections made to the effects area	Effects: alpha channel improvements (especially for fades and titles)	Export: crossfade quality improvement in exported movie (reduced aliasing)	Export: effects mask repaired in exported projects	Export: repaired export cancellation with MPEGLayer2 mono audio	Export: improvements made to Blu-ray export
